_meta.purpose: Sector-relative reference points for the Atlas ESG performance score. Used ONLY to position a borrower against typical peers in its NACE section. Where a borrower's sector is unknown ('OTHER') or required inputs are missing, NO benchmarked score is produced — the engine never fabricates a comparison.

carbon_intensity.unit: tCO2e per EUR million of turnover
carbon_intensity.derivation: Sector GHG intensity per EUR of gross value added (GVA) from CSO Ireland 'Economic Intensity of Greenhouse Gas Emissions by Activity 2023' (NACE Rev.2), cross-checked against Eurostat env_ac_aeint_r2 (EU-27). Converted to a turnover basis using an assumed economy-wide GVA/turnover ratio of 0.45. Because g CO2e/EUR-GVA x 0.45 is numerically equal to tCO2e per EUR-million of turnover, the section median below = (g CO2e/EUR-GVA) x 0.45, rounded to 2 significant figures.
carbon_intensity.confidence: indicative — single-country EU proxy with a flat GVA/turnover assumption. Intended to position a borrower as low/typical/high vs peers, NOT as an audited absolute. Replace per-deployment with the bank's own loan-book medians for production underwriting.
sources: CSO Ireland — Output and Value Added by Activity 2024, 'Economic Intensity of Greenhouse Gas Emissions' (Table 7.1), reference year 2023, NACE Rev.2.
Eurostat — Air emissions intensities by NACE Rev.2 activity (env_ac_aeint_r2); EU-27 all-activity GHG intensity ~124 g CO2e/EUR GVA (2023).

scoring_curve.note: Score is sector-relative. ratio = company_intensity / sector_median. <=0.5 -> 100 (half the typical peer footprint). =1.0 -> 55 (typical). >=3.0 -> 10 (3x+ worse than peers). Linear between anchor points.

absolute_references.note: These are scored on an absolute scale (no sector benchmark needed) because higher/lower is unambiguously better regardless of industry.
absolute_references.renewable_pct: Linear 0% -> 0, 100% -> 100. EU-27 grid renewable share ~45% (2023) shown as context only.
absolute_references.recycling_pct: Linear 0% -> 0, 100% -> 100. EU municipal recycling rate ~48% (Eurostat 2022) shown as context only.
absolute_references.gender_female_pct: Peaks at gender balance. Score = 100 - 2.5 * |pct - 45|, clamped 0-100 (45% treated as balanced midpoint of the 40-50% balance band).
absolute_references.safety_incidents_per_100_fte: Lower is better. 0 -> 100, 1 -> 70, 3 -> 40, >=8 -> 0. Linear between. Indicative bands; sector-specific OSH norms vary.

C.label: Manufacturing
C.note: Manufacturing spans 3 (pharma/electronics) to 4000+ (basic metals, cement) g/EUR-GVA. Section median used; verify against borrower's specific NACE division for heavy industry.

H.label: Transport & Storage
H.note: Land transport ~565 g/EUR-GVA; warehousing far lower; water/air transport extreme outliers. Section value reflects typical MSME land-transport/logistics; verify for shipping/aviation.

K.label: Financial & Insurance
K.note: Operational (Scope 1+2) intensity only. Financed emissions (Scope 3, PCAF) are out of scope and dominate the real footprint of this sector.

OTHER.label: Other / Unclassified
OTHER.note: No sector benchmark — carbon-intensity sub-score is omitted and weights renormalize. Borrower should be reclassified to a specific NACE section for peer comparison.

turnover_midpoints_eur._note: Midpoint EUR used to estimate turnover from the collected range. '1B+' and '<40M' use representative points, flagged as estimates in the score trace.
